messages:
maria.g: Quick huddle — we need final owners for customer comms after last night's partial degradation. Who owns the 72h public summary, statuspage sentence, and RCA access rules?
ryan.k: I can take the statuspage blurb and a single-sentence recurrence note. Ill avoid infra terms.
samir.b: I'll draft the RCA-sharing rules and a short redaction checklist (3–5 bullets).
beth: Looping in @olivia.p for legal review of sharing criteria and consent wording.
olivia.p: Ill review. High-level is fine; we need a consent record for any deeper disclosures.
maria.g: Required outputs: (1) 72h non-technical customer summary, (2) statuspage headline + one-line on recurrence, (3) 3-Q customer FAQ for support, (4) clear gate for full RCA access (consent/NDA + logged request).
ryan.k: Draft statuspage line: "Partial disruption to hosted inference (Apr 2, 2026) — some customers experienced delays after a configuration change. Service restored at 03:18 UTC. We will publish a customer summary within 72 hours." Thoughts?
maria.g: Good. Swap "configuration change" -> "recent configuration rollout" and add the recurrence sentence: "We are investigating a recurring class of incidents and will share validated mitigations when available." Keep both high-level.
samir.b: Proposed RCA gating:
- Full internal RCA: internal only.
- Enterprise technical packet: available on request with documented consent (NDA/consent record).
- Public redacted summary: publish within 72 hours to impacted customers.
- Full redacted timeline + mitigations: publish within 7 business days.
Redaction checklist: strip PII, internal hostnames, raw IPs, and sensitive security-control details.
olivia.p: Legal sign-off pending one change: require the customer to sign an explicit consent template before we share any attachments that include architectural diagrams or sample traces. Beth can draft that template.
beth: Will draft consent template and an opt-in bridge-call checkbox for enterprise support.
support-bot: Note to support: use exact statuspage wording for customer replies; flag any divergence for approval.
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-7001 "Publish 72h customer summary" — assignee: maria.g — due: 1945920000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-7002 "Statuspage update: add recurrence sentence" — assignee: ryan.k — due: 1945760000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-7003 "RCA sharing policy & redaction checklist" — assignee: samir.b — due: 1945800000
maria.g: Owners recap: 72h summary = maria.g; statuspage + recurrence = ryan.k; RCA policy + redaction checklist = samir.b; consent template + bridge opt-in = beth + olivia.p; support sync = support-bot to coordinate.
ryan.k: Ill open the statuspage PR after legal signs off and tag support.
samir.b: Ill link the policy doc to INFRA-772 and add a recurring-incident tag. This is the third similar cache-class tail event in 6 weeks — include that context internally only.
maria.g: Reminder: keep external wording identical across statuspage, support, and direct customer emails. Ill post the 72h draft here for a quick review when ready. End of thread.
